data.name: Sharleen
data.long_meaning: Sharleen is a modern English name derived from the Greek words 'sharos' (graceful) and 'leon' (lion). In Greek mythology, the lion represents courage and strength, while 'sharos' signifies gentleness and freedom. The name Sharleen symbolizes a balance of power and grace, with a gentle spirit that can face challenges with courage.
